answer: An adversary therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 13 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The nebula counter is kept in whisper and relic exposes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 13 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 3673 identities would post 2227 proofs and burn roughly 85 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
